skillNames.intro: World in a Grain of Sand
World in a Grain of Sand

gear.name: Freezing Frost
bonuses: 2pc: Glacio DMG + 10%.
5pc: Glacio DMG + 10% after releasing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack. This effect stacks up to 3 times, each stack lasts 15s.

gear.name: Molten Rift
bonuses: 2pc: Fusion DMG + 10%.
5pc: Fusion DMG + 30% for 15s after releasing Resonance Skill.

gear.name: Void Thunder
bonuses: 2pc: Electro DMG + 10%.
5pc: Electro DMG + 15% after releasing Heavy Attack or Resonance Skill. This effect stacks up to 2 times, each stack lasts 15s.

gear.name: Sierra Gale
bonuses: 2pc: Aero DMG + 10%.
5pc: Aero DMG + 30% for 15s after releasing Intro Skill.

gear.name: Celestial Light
bonuses: 2pc: Spectro DMG + 10%.
5pc: Spectro DMG + 30% for 15s after releasing Intro Skill.

gear.name: Havoc Eclipse
bonuses: 2pc: Havoc DMG + 10%.
5pc: Havoc DMG + 7.5% after releasing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack. This effect stacks up to 4 times, each stack lasts 15s.

gear.name: Rejuvenating Glow
bonuses: 2pc: Healing Bonus + 10%.
5pc: Increases the ATK of all party members by 15% for 30s upon healing allies.

gear.name: Moonlit Clouds
bonuses: 2pc: Energy Regen + 10%.
5pc: Upon using Outro Skill, increases the ATK of the next Resonator by 22.5% for 15s.

gear.name: Lingering Tunes
bonuses: 2pc: ATK +10%
5pc: While on the field, ATK increases by 5% every 1.5s. This effect stacks up to 4 times. Outro Skill DMG + 60%.

gear.name: Frosty Resolve
bonuses: 2pc: Resonance Skill DMG + 12%
5pc: Casting Resonance Skill grants 22.5% Glacio DMG Bonus for 15s and casting Resonance Liberation increases Resonance Skill DMG by 18%, lasting for 5s. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

gear.name: Eternal Radiance
bonuses: 2pc: Spectro DMG + 10%
5pc: Inflicting Spectro Frazzle on enemies increases Crit. Rate by 20% for 15s. Attacking enemies inflicted with 10 stacks of Spectro Frazzle grants 15% Spectro DMG Bonus for 15s.

gear.name: Midnight Veil
bonuses: 2pc: Havoc DMG + 10%
5pc: When Outro Skill is triggered, deal additional 480% Havoc DMG to surrounding enemies, considered Outro Skill DMG, and grant the incoming Resonator 15% Havoc DMG Bonus for 15s.

gear.name: Empyrean Anthem
bonuses: 2pc: Energy Regen + 10%
5pc: Increase the Resonator's Coordinated Attack DMG by 80%. Upon a critical hit of Coordinated Attack, increase the active Resonator's ATK by 20% for 4s.

gear.name: Tidebreaking Courage
bonuses: 2pc: Energy Regen + 10%
5pc: Increase the Resonator's ATK by 15%. Reaching 250% Energy Regen increases all Attribute DMG by 30% for the Resonator.

gear.name: Wrath of the Deep
bonuses: 2pc: Max HP + 10%

5pc: When the Resonator has a shield, their max HP is increased by 20%. Upon losing HP, the Resonator's Crit. Rate is increased by 5% for 15s, triggered up to once every second, stacking up to 3 times.

gear.name: Gusts of Welkin
bonuses: 2pc: Aero DMG + 10%
5pc: Inflicting Aero Erosion upon enemies increases Aero DMG for all Resonators in the team by 15%, and for the Resonator triggering this effect by an additional 15%, lasting for 20s.

gear.name: Windward Pilgrimage
bonuses: 2pc: Aero DMG + 10%
5pc: Hitting a target with Aero Erosion increases Crit. Rate by 10% and grants 30% Aero DMG Bonus, lasting for 10s.

gear.name: Flaming Clawprint
bonuses: 2pc: Fusion DMG + 10%
5pc: Casting Resonance Liberation grants all Resonators in the team 15% Fusion DMG Bonus and the caster 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus, lasting for 35s.

gear.name: Dream of the Lost
bonuses: 2pc: Holding 0 Resonance Energy increases Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 35% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

gear.name: Crown of Valor
bonuses: 2pc: Upon gaining a Shield, increase the Resonator's ATK by 6% and Crit. DMG by 4% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s and stacks up to 5 times.

gear.name: Law of Harmony
bonuses: 2pc: Casting Echo Skill grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the caster for 4s. Additionally, all Resonators in the team gain 4% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. Echoes of the same name can only trigger this effect once. The record of Echo triggering this effect is cleared along with this effect. At 4 stacks, casting Echo Skill again resets the duration of this effect.

gear.name: Flamewing's Shadow
bonuses: 2pc: Dealing Echo Skill DMG increases Heavy Attack Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. Dealing Heavy Attack DMG increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20% for 6s. While both effects are active, gain 16% Fusion DMG Bonus.

gear.name: Thread of Severed Fate
bonuses: 2pc: Inflicting Havoc Bane increases the Resonator's ATK by 20% and grants 30% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 5s.

gear.name: Pact of Neonlight Leap
bonuses: 2pc: Spectro DMG + 10%

5pc: Casting Outro Skill increases the ATK of the incoming Resonator who casts Intro Skill by 15%. Each point of Tune Break Boost the incoming Resonator has additionally increases their ATK by 0.3%, up to 15%. This effect lasts for 15s, or until the Resonator is switched out.

gear.name: Halo of Starry Radiance
bonuses: 2pc: Healing Bonus + 10%.
5pc: When healing a Resonator in the team, every 1% of Off-Tune Buildup Rate grants a 0.2% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team for 4s, up to 25%. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

gear.name: Rite of Gilded Revelation
bonuses: 2pc: Spectro DMG + 10%
5pc: Dealing Basic Attack DMG increases Spectro DMG by 10% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 stacks, casting Resonance Liberation grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

gear.name: Trailblazing Star
bonuses: 2pc: Fusion DMG + 10%
5pc: Inflicting Fusion Burst or Tune Rupture - Shifting increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 20% and grants 20% Fusion DMG Bonus for 8s.

gear.name: Chromatic Foam
bonuses: 2pc: Fusion DMG + 10%

5pc: When the Resonator inflicts Fusion Burst on the enemies, they gain the following effects: Gain 10% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15 s. While this effect is active, casting an Outro Skill grants the incoming Resonator 25% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s.

gear.name: Sound of True Name
bonuses: 2pc: Aero DMG + 10%
5pc: Dealing Echo Skill DMG to enemies increases the Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 20%, and grants 15% Aero DMG Bonus for 5s.
